Receive a minimum of $20,000 in combined qualifying deposits within 60 days of account opening; transfers from existing Equity Bank accounts do NOT count.
Activate and use the Equity Bank debit card within 60 days of account opening.
When opening at an Equity Bank location, mention the 'Biz1000' offer at time of opening; no online promo-code path is described for Biz1000.
One offer per business; new Equity Bank business accounts only (applicant not linked as owner to an open Equity Bank business checking/savings within the past 180 days); employees excluded.
We may collect the bonus back if the account is closed within the first 180 days after account opening.
Minimum $100 deposit may be required to open; customer is issued a 1099-INT for the bonus.
This is Equity Bank (Wichita, KS — equitybank.com), not any other institution with a similar name.
